_about: Source images for the site's heroes and About photo. Generators copy them byte-identically into docs/assets/img/ (scripts/design_system.py emit_assets). Hero crops are 16:9 cuts of the ESA/Webb Large JPEGs (phones get 9:16 portrait centre crops of the 3840 px cut, hero_<key>_p720 / _p1080), re-encoded without metadata; every page that shows one prints its credit line. The photo is the site author's own portrait (EXIF-free copies only).
